defects_fixed_20260711.description: voicing_type='inversion' had no transform: bass_note stayed as root, upper unchanged. Produced identical WAV to 'full'.
defects_fixed_20260711.fix: Added inversion case in _voicing_transform: bass_note = 3rd+'2', bass_pc = 3rd pitch class.

defects_fixed_20260711.description: voicing_type='rootless' only filtered root from upper_notes, but upper_notes never contain the root (root is in bass_note only). No bass change. Produced identical WAV to 'full'.
defects_fixed_20260711.fix: Changed bass_note to 7th (or 5th fallback for triads) and used pitch-class comparison.

defects_fixed_20260711.description: voicing_type='shell' filtered to keep_intervals={root, 3rd, 7th}, but upper_notes never contain root. Same result as no5 (3rd+7th). Produced identical WAV to 'no5'.
defects_fixed_20260711.fix: Shell now adds root note at octave 3 to upper voices, producing distinct audio from no5.

defects_fixed_20260711.description: no5 used hardcoded fifth_pc = (root + 7) % 12 (perfect 5th). Failed for m7b5 chords whose 5th is diminished (interval 6). Eb vs D# enharmonic mismatch also caused filter failure.
defects_fixed_20260711.fix: Scan chord intervals for any fifth-degree interval {6,7,8}. Compare by pitch class via _note_pc() instead of string matching.

defects_fixed_20260711.description: All note comparisons used n[0] or .startswith(), which fails for two-character note names (e.g., 'Eb' key was 'B' for 'Bb3', 'D#' from NOTE_NAMES != 'Eb' from upper_notes).
defects_fixed_20260711.fix: Added _note_letter() and _note_pc() helpers. All comparisons now use pitch class (0-11) via NOTE_TO_PC map.
